run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with the mailing list CC'd
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with custom --cc flags to add extra reviewers to the patch upload
review_main_function: review the main function that parses CLI args and appends the GTest group to the CC list
refactor_main_function: refactor the main function to support additional default CC recipients beyond the GTest group
summarize_upload_gtest: summarize the upload_gtest.py wrapper script that delegates to upload.py with an auto-added CC address
